summary: Consolidate the obsolete ʕfr hearing-error entry with ḥfr

data.preserve_note: 07.11.2018: this is a Hörfehler of Ritter.

rationale: The lookup for ʕfr has the same digging sense and both of its examples recur in ḥfr: the Steinhacke example at 94/17 and the personal-communication example about nqurto. The only relevant differences are the initial ʕ/ḥ readings and minor transcription differences. The ʕfr head itself explicitly identifies the reading as Ritter's hearing error, so this is documented duplicate coverage of the same verb. Preserve that provenance when consolidating.
The supplied 24/193 translation has 'eine Manneslänge tief'; the entry loses the initial M and incorrectly capitalizes the following adjective.

The quoted ḥǝfriwayna belongs to ḥfr 'graben, aushauen', and mi šeno identifies the rock from which the material was excavated. English 'soiled' means made dirty and mistranslates this action. The supplied MAC Ishaq old houses/62 independently describes nqurto dḥufríwayla as aggregate 'which they had dug out'.
The direction word is misspelled. The supplied 116/31 translation reads 'nach links und rechts um'.
